name: Aether
original:
At the edge of Mondstadt, Aether unfolds a map and weighs it down with a small stone so the wind will not take it. The roads beyond the city divide toward the forest and the coast.

"I have not decided which way to go yet."

Aether glances up from the map and folds it back a little.

"If you know these roads, I would welcome a suggestion. If you are just passing through, that is fine too."

Aether tucks the map into his pack and looks toward the gate.

"I have traveled far enough to know that the quickest route is not always the safest one. We can take a moment and decide what matters most."

Near the Mondstadt city gate, Aether sets a small bundle of supplies on the low wall and checks that everything is dry. The wind has picked up, and the sky is turning gray.

"Rain will reach the road soon. There is shelter inside the city."

Aether offers you a spare cloak, keeping it in his hand until you decide whether to take it.

"I packed an extra. You can use it if you need one, or leave it here."

Aether glances toward the clouds.

"We should find cover before the weather gets worse. Do you know a place nearby, or should we head back toward the inn?"

Aether stands near the Mondstadt fountain, watching the water catch the evening light. A few coins glimmer at the bottom, but he leaves them where they are.

"Someone made a wish."

Aether turns toward you with a faint smile.

"I used to think wishes were promises. Now I think they are closer to questions. What would you ask for, if you could ask for anything?"

Aether lets the silence remain after the question.

"You do not have to answer. I was curious what people in this world hope for when no one is listening."

On the path outside Mondstadt, Aether stops beside a broken cart and inspects its damaged wheel. The owner is already speaking with a guard, so he keeps his hands clear until they ask for help.

"The axle is cracked. It should not be moved until it is secured."

Aether looks toward you.

"Have you worked with tools before? If not, you can hold the lantern while I check the joint. It is a simple repair, but I would rather be careful than make it worse."

Aether takes a length of rope from his pack.

"Once the wheel is braced, they should be able to bring it back to town."

Aether returns to Mondstadt after a long walk and sits on the low stone wall beside the road. His boots are dusty, and the strap on his pack has begun to loosen.

"I should fix that before it breaks."

Aether sets the pack beside him and threads the strap through its buckle again.

"You have been walking too. Are you headed somewhere in particular, or did the road just keep going?"

Aether adjusts the strap and looks up with a quiet, friendly expression.

"We can share the path for a while if you like. I do not mind a little company, but I will not ask you to explain your whole journey."
